name: tracerazor
description: Local-first efficiency supervision for AI-agent runs.

interface.shortDescription: Audit and improve agent efficiency locally
interface.longDescription: Capture agent runs, diagnose structural token waste, preview safe changes, and verify measured improvements without sending traces to a cloud service.
defaultPrompt: Audit the latest agent run and explain the most important waste signals.
Compare these two runs and verify whether token usage improved without reducing task quality.
